description: Eight-channel multi-stage envelope generator and complex LFO: each channel plays a shape you draw, with its own VCA, CV output, trigger modes, crossover and sidechain trigger detection

params.text: Sets the cycle length of that channel, 0.56ms to 30 minutes; right-clicking it takes a length typed in seconds
Sets how many times the shape cycles once it starts playing, 1 to 99, or endlessly at the INF setting
Holds the shape back by as many as 8192 samples after a trigger arrives, in Trigger and Sidechain modes
Runs alternate cycles fast and the ones between them slow, -99% to +99%
Shifts the shape through its cycle, 0 to 360 degrees
Stretches or compresses the shape vertically along an exponential curve, -100% to +100%
Stretches the shape horizontally towards one end of the cycle and compresses it at the other, -100% to +100%
Attenuates the output voltage, 0 to 100%
Limits how fast the output voltage can change, measured against the cycle length so that 50% turns a square wave into a triangle
Filters the output voltage to soften the clicks that steep vertical changes in the shape make, 0 to 100%
Splits the audio through the VCA into a low band and a high band at this frequency, 20Hz to 20kHz, and turns the crossover off at its lowest setting
Attenuates how far the shape modulates the high band of the VCA, 0 to 100%
Attenuates how far the shape modulates the low band of the VCA, 0 to 100%
Sets the level the sidechain envelope follower has to pass for a trigger to be generated, 0 to 100%
Starts the playhead on that channel, and pressing it during play stops the playhead and resets it; alt-clicking resets the channel
Holds the playhead in place, with the voltage under it held at the CV output
Steps through off, a sustain marker the playhead holds at while the gate is high, and a pair of loop markers the playhead runs between while the gate is high
Hard-syncs the cycle length to a clock; it is fixed off in this module and works only in ShapeMaster Pro
Quantises triggers and length changes to a main clock pulse, and does nothing unless sync is on
Sends the sidechain audio to that channel's VCA output for listening
Loads the previous preset in the same folder, replacing the shape and every front panel control on that channel
Loads the next preset in the same folder, replacing the shape and every front panel control on that channel
Loads the previous shape in the same folder, leaving every control on that channel untouched
Loads the next shape in the same folder, leaving every control on that channel untouched
Resets all eight channels
Starts and stops all eight channels; a channel plays only while run is on and its own play button is on
Opens the advanced sidechain settings for the selected channel: use VCA input, gain adjust, a 24dB per octave high pass and low pass, hysteresis, hold off and sensitivity

inputs.text: Audio into that channel's VCA, whose gain the shape modulates over 0-10V whatever the CV range is set to
Starts the shape on that channel from a trigger or a gate, and sets the playhead position directly when the channel is in CV mode
A trigger resets all eight channels
A trigger toggles run on and off
Polyphonic audio the trigger levels read, its channels 1 to 8 feeding ShapeMaster channels 1 to 8

outputs.text: That channel's VCA input with the shape applied to its amplitude
The shape as a control voltage, over the range picked in the graph window

notes: a channel plays only while run is on and that channel's play button is on; in Trigger, Gate or Sidechain mode it starts only when something arrives at its TRIG input.
double-clicking in the graph window adds a node and double-clicking a node deletes it; shift-dragging draws a stepped pattern, and alt or ctrl dragging snaps a node to the grid.
right-clicking in the graph window opens a menu of its own carrying Add node, and right-clicking a node opens one with that node's time and voltage and a Delete node item.
right-clicking a channel button opens that channel's own menu, with its label and colour, gain adjust at the VCA input, poly VCA summing, retrigger, and copy, paste and initialise.
hard sync to a clock belongs to ShapeMaster Pro: this build has no clock jack and its cycle lengths are set in time rather than in bars and beats.
menu: Run off setting — stops and resets every channel when run goes off, or freezes them where they are
Show channel labels — draws each channel's name in the graph window
Show node tooltip — reads out the voltage and the time of a node while the pointer is over it
Show shape nodes — hides the nodes and the curve control points until one is under the pointer
Line width — a slider setting the thickness of the shape, 0.3pt to 2pt
Shadow — picks which side of the shape the shaded area is drawn on
Knob label display colour — sets the colour of the readouts under the knobs
Knob arcs — draws the knob position arc, the CV arc, both or neither
Cloaked mode — turns off the drawing that is not needed, to save processor time

inputs.17: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.18: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
